-- Questee: anyone with a sickle

DisplayName: Forage for Plants

QRC:

<ce> and some _plant2_!

<ce> some _plant2_ and some _plant3_!

QBN:

Item _plant1_ small_plant
Item _plant2_ large_plant
Item _plant3_ small_plant

Item _armor_ armor
Item _magic_ magic_item
Item _misc_ misc
Item _flamable_ flamable
Item _trinket_ trinket

Item _skin_ skin
Item _mythic_ mythic
Item _mineral_ mineral


-- Quest start-up:

_weakint_ task:
	when attribute Intelligence is at least 0

_evenint_ task:
	when attribute Intelligence is at least 40

_strongint_ task:
	when attribute Intelligence is at least 60

_verystrongint_ task:
	when attribute Intelligence is at least 80

_worstchanceint_ task:
	when _weakint_ and not _evenint_

_evenchanceint_ task:
	when _evenint_ and not _strongint_

_goodchanceint_ task:
	when _strongint_ and not _verystrongint_

_bestchanceint_ task:
	when _verystrongint_

_weakluc_ task:
	when attribute Luck is at least 0

_evenluc_ task:
	when attribute Luck is at least 40

_strongluc_ task:
	when attribute Luck is at least 60

_verystrongluc_ task:
	when attribute Luck is at least 80

_worstchanceluc_ task:
	when _weakluc_ and not _evenluc_

_evenchanceluc_ task:
	when _evenluc_ and not _strongluc_

_goodchanceluc_ task:
	when _strongluc_ and not _verystrongluc_

_bestchanceluc_ task:
	when _verystrongluc_

_intweak_ task:
	when _worstchanceint_
	reduce player fatigue by 15
	raise time by 1:30
	pick one of _0plant_ _0plant_ _0plant_ _1plant_ _1plant_ _2plant_

_inteven_ task:
	when _evenchanceint_
	reduce player fatigue by 15
	raise time by 1:30
	pick one of _0plant_ _0plant_ _1plant_ _1plant_ _2plant_ _2plant_

_intgood_ task:
	when _goodchanceint_
	reduce player fatigue by 15
	raise time by 1:30
	pick one of _0plant_ _1plant_ _1plant_ _2plant_ _2plant_ _3plant_

_intbest_ task:
	when _bestchanceint_
	reduce player fatigue by 15
	raise time by 1:30
	pick one of _1plant_ _1plant_ _2plant_ _2plant_ _3plant_ _3plant_

_0plant_ task:
	say 1013

_1plant_ task:
	say 1014
	get item _plant1_
	make _plant1_ permanent

_2plant_ task:
	say 1015
	get item _plant1_
	make _plant1_ permanent
	get item _plant2_
	make _plant2_ permanent

_3plant_ task:
	say 1016
	get item _plant1_
	make _plant1_ permanent
	get item _plant2_
	make _plant2_ permanent
	get item _plant3_
	make _plant3_ permanent

_plantchopped_ task:
	when _0plant_ or _1plant_ or _2plant_ or _3plant_

_bonusweak_ task:
	when _plantchopped_ and _worstchanceluc_
	pick one of _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _1bonus_

_bonuseven_ task:
	when _plantchopped_ and _evenchanceluc_
	pick one of _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _1bonus_ _1bonus_

_bonusgood_ task:
	when _plantchopped_ and _goodchanceluc_
	pick one of _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _1bonus_ _1bonus_ _1bonus_

_bonusbest_ task:
	when _plantchopped_ and _bestchanceluc_
	pick one of _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _1bonus_ _1bonus_ _1bonus_ _1bonus_

_0bonus_ task:
	end quest

_1bonus_ task:
	pick one of _randomingredient_ _randomingredient_ _randomingredient_ _randomingredient_ _randomitem_

_randomitem_ task:
	pick one of _weaponitem_ _armoritem_ _magicitem_ _bookitem_ _potionitem_ _mapitem_ _miscitem_
	
_randomingredient_ task:
	pick one of _coinsitem_ _flamableitem_ _flamableitem_ _organitem_ _skinitem_ _mythicitem_ _mineralitem_ _trinketitem_

_weaponitem_ task:
	update-quest-item _weapon_ Leveled
	say 1018
	get item _weapon_
	make _weapon_ permanent
	end quest

_armoritem_ task:
	update-quest-item _armor_ Leveled
	say 1019
	get item _armor_
	make _armor_ permanent
	end quest

_magicitem_ task:
	say 1020
	get item _magic_
	make _magic_ permanent
	end quest

_miscitem_ task:
	say 1021
	get item _misc_
	make _misc_ permanent
	end quest

_flamableitem_ task:
	say 1022
	get item _flamable_
	make _flamable_ permanent
	end quest

_trinketitem_ task:
	say 1023
	get item _trinket_
	make _trinket_ permanent
	end quest

_bookitem_ task:
	say 1024
	get item _book_
	make _book_ permanent
	end quest

_potionitem_ task:
	say 1025
	get item _potion_
	make _potion_ permanent
	end quest

_mapitem_ task:
	say 1026
	get item _map_
	make _map_ permanent
	end quest

_coinsitem_ task:
	say 1028
	get item _coins_
	make _coins_ permanent
	end quest

_organitem_ task:
	say 1032
	get item _organ_
	make _organ_ permanent
	end quest

_skinitem_ task:
	say 1033
	get item _skin_
	make _skin_ permanent
	end quest

_mythicitem_ task:
	say 1034
	get item _mythic_
	make _mythic_ permanent
	end quest

_mineralitem_ task:
	say 1035
	get item _mineral_
	make _mineral_ permanent
	end quest
